text: This report recommends that the name "Paese Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located south of College Street, extending between Manning Avenue and Euclid Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Paese Lane" for an existing public lane located south of College Street, extending between Manning Avenue and Euclid Avenue.
